reason: C93 on 48 select maps has detection precision ~16% and recall 33-39%, but AP is well above coarse. Test whether sparse weak exemplars or omitted directional response explain the bottleneck without fitting a neural network. Eightfold more reference pixels, same 80 calibration terrains; all 48 selector and 484 confirmation terrain IDs disjoint. Keep the query features frozen to C93 chosen flow, identical K, operating rule and geometry. Evaluate the density comparison independently of finite-phase controls so mechanisms remain separate.
calibration: 4096 uniform positions/map, original 512 are first. Fixed reference library, no neural or tree optimization. Five independent terrain folds to calibrate F1; separately compare dB-MSE decision threshold (including abstention) selected entirely on calibration terrain folds with true negative cost. Use the latter only as a deployment sanity check, no C82 and physical weighting.
decision: Both-band precision/recall>=.30, true-event depth MAE reduction>=1, and unconditional improvement>=.08 both still required before main training. Preserve full threshold precision/recall frontier and the 1dB depth tolerance.
